<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">KitesurfeR’S GLAMOUR</h2><h1 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">MAKI BUNGALOW</h1><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Enjoy the unique experience of staying in our impressive A-frame bungalows, standing 5.5 metres high. Tastefully furnished, naturally ventilated and sheltered from the wind, they face the beautiful wild forest of Sakalava, where you may spot lemurs, chameleons and exotic birds in their natural habitat.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The three Maki Bungalows share <strong>two bathrooms and two toilets</strong>.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>To preserve the authentic open-air atmosphere of the bungalows, the entrance is fitted with curtains instead of solid doors.</strong> Please note that these bungalows are designed for guests looking for a simple, eco-friendly nature experience rather than a conventional hotel room.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Wake up surrounded by nature and enjoy one of the most unique accommodation experiences in Madagascar.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><br>Size : 20m2<br>1 big bed : 160cmx200cm<br>Chest of drawers<br>Table and chair to work with you computer</strong><br><strong>Private wooden terrace<br>Two bathrooms and two toilets for three Maki Bungalow<br>Power outlets<br>Safe box</strong></p><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>PRICE -&nbsp;45€</strong></h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Prices for 2 guests sleeping in the same bed, <strong>including breakfasts</strong><br>15€ per additional guest<br>Maximum 3 guests</p><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><em>FREE ACCESS TO THE GYM!</em></strong></h2>
